newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians march, Israelis fire in air -general.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians march, Israelis fire in air -general.

text.p: Palestinian police stopped hundreds of Palestinians protesters from marching on a Jewish settlement in the Gaza Strip on Thursday as fierce anti-Israeli demonstrations entered another day, a Palestinian general said.
General Abdel-Razik al-Majayda, commander of Gaza police forces, said Israeli soldiers and settlers near the settlement of Kfar Darom fired shots in the air but none of the demonstrators was hurt.
There was no immediate confirmation of an Israel Radio report that a settler and soldier were lightly hurt by stones hurled by the Palestinians.
Majayda said Palestinian policemen stopped the protesters from getting through a roadblock.
Israel Radio reported stone-throwing incidents in the Jerusalem area. Elsewhere in the West Bank and Gaza Strip, Palestinians staged a commercial strike.

Palestinian anger at Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's failure to extend self-rule in the West Bank and Gaza boiled over after his right-wing government decided to open a tunnel beside Islam's third holiest site in Jerusalem. Security forces sealed off the West Bank and the Gaza Strip.
